appraisal_events.evidence: Je vois sur votre table un ouvrage de Bergotte... ces joies mêmes, c'est un puissant remède, le plus puissant de tous peut-être.
appraisal_events.explanation: Cottard singles out the grandmother's Bergotte book and characterizes the joy it gives her as one of the most powerful remedies available, an indirect but clear elevation of the value of Bergotte's work.

status_effects.explanation: His work is credited by the doctor with a rare, near-medicinal power to console, a mild local elevation of his literary standing within the scene.
